statement: Every fixture listed here is SYNTHETIC: hand-written for testing software behavior. None is PoB output, a live provider response, or a gameplay measurement, and none may be cited as evidence about PoE 2 mechanics.

fixtures.author: P00-T02
fixtures.description: Minimal hand-written PoB2 Huntress with no socket groups, no passives and no items; loads successfully and its FullDPS is a legitimate zero.
fixtures.caveat: Hand-written against the element names observed in PoB2 export files. Not produced by PoB and not a real character.

fixtures.author: P00-T02
fixtures.caveat: Invalid on purpose. Never repair it in place; add a new fixture instead.

fixtures.author: P02-T03
fixtures.description: An invented game world in the row shapes the engine reports: two classes, a fourteen-node tree with one isolated node, a jewel socket, a choice node with no option list, eight gems, three item bases and the slot table. The real P02-T02 exporter turns it into a GameCatalog and a PatchProfile for the legality tests.
fixtures.caveat: Every id, name and number is invented. The citations the tests pair it with are real and come from docs/evidence/P02/catalog-rows-slice.json; these rows are not, and nothing here says anything about Path of Exile 2.

fixtures.author: P02-T03
fixtures.description: One legality case per rule, each violating that rule alone, with the legal boundary value beside it and one combined case breaking six rules at once. Each case carries the violations, unknowns, cited gaps and per-check decisions it expects.
fixtures.caveat: The expectations were written by hand from the exported rules and the task description, not produced by running the validator. The builds and items are invented and none of them is a measurement.

fixtures.author: P09-T01
fixtures.description: The p09-synthetic-v1 encounter suite: four ScenarioSpec records in the four shapes of docs/specs/scenarios.md, a clear and a boss RotationPolicy, the fourteen DataGap records naming every input a representative suite still needs, and a hand-computable oracle. Regenerated by `python scripts/p09_t01_suite.py`.
fixtures.caveat: Every entity, count, health value, position, duration and window is a test constant chosen so the arithmetic is checkable by hand. None is a PoE 2 monster or a recorded encounter timing. A result produced on this suite is not map clear speed and not boss kill time, and it may not be used to fit any constant.
